thread.title: Netanyahu: Israel Is Seizing Territory in Gaza to Pressure Hamas on Hostages
thread.title_full: Netanyahu: Israel Is Seizing Territory in Gaza to Pressure Hamas on Hostages

author: ?this
text:
Jeez, you clearly have no idea what you are talking about. You must teach "Anti-Colonialism and Head Scarves" at Harvard (or is it Columbia?).
You also have no sources to back your statements. And the fact that Iran and Hamas are different sects of Islam is meaningless; Iran clearly backs other Sunni groups when it wants to.
"Since the early 1990s, the Islamic Republic of Iran has been sponsoring Hamas with military aid and training and financial aid. Iran has remained a key patron of Hamas , providing them with funds, weapons, and training.
Iran provides about $100 million annually to Palestinian militant groups, including Hamas. As of 2023...Iran had significantly increased its funding for Hamas to $350 million a year."
Iran equipped and trained Hamas fighters immediately prior to Oct. 7, and gave them the green light to kill civilians. ttps://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iranian_support_for_Hamas#:~:text=Since%20the%20early%201990s%2C%20the,funds%2C%20weapons%2C%20and%20training.
